name: rent_roll_units
description: One row per unit from a residential rent roll detail report. The report lists each unit as a block: a unit line followed by its scheduled charge lines (rent, fees, utilities). Fold each block into one row.

property_name.name: Property
property_name.original: Property name from the report header. Same for every row.
property_name.description: Extract the property name from the report header as a name. The value is the same for every row.

report_period.name: Report Period
report_period.original: The month and year the rent roll is for, as YYYY-MM. Same for every row.
report_period.description: Extract the month and year the rent roll is for in YYYY-MM format. The value is the same for every row.

unit_number.name: Unit
unit_number.original: The unit identifier exactly as shown in the unit column, e.g. 100-101. One per row.
unit_number.description: Extract the unit identifier exactly as shown in the unit column, such as 100-101. Output one identifier per row.

unit_type_code.name: Unit Type
unit_type_code.original: Floor plan or unit type code for the unit, e.g. C5.
unit_type_code.description: Extract the floor plan or unit type code for the unit, such as C5.

unit_square_feet.name: Square Feet
unit_square_feet.original: Square footage of the unit, as a number.
unit_square_feet.description: Extract the unit's square footage as a number.

unit_status.name: Unit Status
unit_status.original: Status of the unit exactly as shown, e.g. 'Occupied No Notice', 'Vacant Unrented', 'Notice Rented'.
unit_status.description: Extract the unit status exactly as shown, such as 'Occupied No Notice', 'Vacant Unrented', or 'Notice Rented'.

resident_name.name: Resident
resident_name.original: Resident name as shown. null for vacant units.
resident_name.description: Extract the resident name as shown. Return null for vacant units.

market_rent.name: Market Rent
market_rent.original: Market rent for the unit, as a number.
market_rent.description: Extract the market rent for the unit as a number.

monthly_rent.name: Scheduled Rent
monthly_rent.original: The scheduled monthly charge on the unit's 'Rent' charge line, as a number. 0 if the unit has no rent charge line.
monthly_rent.description: Extract the scheduled monthly charge amount from the unit's Rent charge line as a number. Return 0 if the unit has no Rent charge line.

monthly_other_charges.name: Other Scheduled Charges
monthly_other_charges.original: Sum of all scheduled charge lines for the unit other than Rent (fees, utilities, storage, pet), as a number. 0 if none.
monthly_other_charges.description: Sum the scheduled charge lines for the unit other than the line labeled Rent, including fees, utilities, storage, and pet charges. Return the sum as a number, or 0 if there are no such charges.

operands.other_charge_amounts: Amounts from all scheduled charge lines in this unit's block except the Rent charge line; include fees, utilities, storage, and pet charges.

monthly_total_charges.name: Total Scheduled Charges
monthly_total_charges.original: The unit's charge total as shown on its 'Charge Total' line, as a number. Should equal rent plus other charges.
monthly_total_charges.description: Extract the unit's charge total as shown on its Charge Total line as a number. This should equal scheduled rent plus other scheduled charges.

deposit_held.name: Deposit Held
deposit_held.original: Security deposit held for the unit, as a number. 0 if none.
deposit_held.description: Extract the security deposit held for the unit as a number. Return 0 if none.

balance.name: Balance
balance.original: Outstanding resident balance for the unit, as a number. Negative numbers stay negative.
balance.description: Extract the outstanding resident balance for the unit as a number. Preserve negative values as negative.

move_in_date.name: Move-In Date
move_in_date.original: Move-in date, YYYY-MM-DD. null if blank.
move_in_date.description: Extract the move-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Return null if blank.

lease_start_date.name: Lease Start
lease_start_date.original: Lease start date, YYYY-MM-DD. null if blank.
lease_start_date.description: Extract the lease start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Return null if blank.

lease_end_date.name: Lease End
lease_end_date.original: Lease end date, YYYY-MM-DD. null if blank.
lease_end_date.description: Extract the lease end date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Return null if blank.

expected_move_out_date.name: Expected Move-Out
expected_move_out_date.original: Expected move-out date, YYYY-MM-DD. null if blank.
expected_move_out_date.description: Extract the expected move-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Return null if blank.
